headline: Spot gold recovers slightly to $3,730 per ounce after touching 14-month low
summary: Spot gold rose 0.2% to $3,730.61 per ounce after touching its lowest level since September 2025 as Federal Reserve rate expectations capped gains.
why: Gold is a key global reserve asset and hedge against inflation and monetary easing.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Bargain buying provided a temporary rebound following recent multi-month lows.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bargain hunting pushed spot gold up 0.2% after prices touched a 14-month trough.
